tips.text: Minimalism is about removing visual noise, not only wearing black: grey, brown, navy, cream, olive or burgundy work as long as pieces don't compete.
tips.why: Silhouette, fabric and the wearer matter more than decoration.

tips.text: Mix refined and worn-in: a pristine wool overcoat over a sweater and worn jeans, or a cashmere knit under an old leather jacket.
tips.why: The contrast keeps minimal outfits from looking sterile.

tips.text: Choose controlled volume: trousers with room through the hip that taper gently, and relaxed jackets that still follow the body.
tips.why: It sits between 2010s skinny and today's oversized extremes.

tips.text: You can look grown-up without a tie: a black crew neck loosely tucked into charcoal wool trousers, or a white tee under a dark blazer.
tips.why: Maturity comes from proportion, restraint and materials.

tips.text: Start a minimal wardrobe with trousers that have presence: pleated or flat-front charcoal wool that doesn't cling to thigh or calf.
tips.why: Fuller trousers give simple tops shape.

tips.text: A long coat creates a vertical line that makes almost anything underneath look more elegant, even jeans and a tee.
Don't buy everything from one shop; a mix of basics, a vintage coat and existing shirts looks lived-in rather than like a set.
Contrast soft and hard materials: wool trousers with leather shoes, knitwear under a leather jacket, a structured leather bag with relaxed clothes.
tips.why: Hard materials stop minimalism looking bland.

tips.text: A minimal wardrobe: a white shirt, a couple of crew necks, a dark turtleneck, a soft dark blazer, charcoal and one other pair of trousers, straight dark jeans, a long coat, a leather jacket, simple sneakers or loafers.
Tight all-black clothes such as skinny black jeans, a tight shirt and a cropped jacket miss the point of minimalism; the clothes need air around the body.
tips.why: Colour alone doesn't make the look; silhouette does.

tips.text: In a charcoal, black and grey outfit, let texture do the work that pattern would normally do.
Don't panic when an outfit feels simple; three very good pieces can be enough.
tips.why: Adding more stops adding to the person.
